how: X's placed parlays: what X Parlays shows, read only, on the site owner's devices (a browser signed in through the NFL hub's admin link, which keeps its record under nflhub_admin_v1 on the same origin; no one else's page has the tab or reads this file, which stays public all the same). Claude keeps this file from the slips the owner sends in chat; the page only reads it, no-store on every load of the owner's browser. A parlay is id (any name not used before), placed (the Eastern date it was placed), stake, price (the American odds it was placed at), payout (what it pays, stake included), note (optional) and legs. A leg is game (the game's ESPN event id, as the state's games have it) and either a team bet, kind ml (side home or away), pl (side home or away, line the puck line from that side, e.g. -1.5) or ou (side over or under, line the total), or a player's line, kind prop: pid (his ESPN athlete id), name (as ESPN spells him), team, stat (pts, g, a, s, bs or sv), and side over or under at line (a main line, e.g. 0.5), or mk yes at k for a milestone (k+, the anytime goal is g at k 1). A line the book moved before X placed the bet is written as the line X took. The page grades each leg as it grades a saved parlay: a team bet on the final's score, a player's line on the box score the state carries (void where he did not play, a goalie's saves void unless he started). A slip settled two Eastern days before today leaves the tab by itself; one marked cleared: true here never shows. updated is when this file last changed what X Parlays shows.
